Maya (People Ops): Heads up — Sebastian submitted resignation; last day 2026-07-10. We need to confirm benefits cutoff, COBRA mailing address, asset return (remote UK), and SSO deprovision timing.
Sebastian: Confirm last day 2026-07-10. Personal email is sebastian.home@mail.com and UK address is 14A Bridge St, London, SW1A 1AA.
Clara (Payroll): Final paycheck processed the next payroll after 7/10. PTO payout per policy; submit remaining PTO balance here: https://hr.redwood.com/pto.
Ravi (IT): Standard: revoke VPN & PATs same day after EOD, SSO deprovision next morning 7/11 08:00 BST unless manager requests otherwise. Sebastian — can you list any service accounts/keys you own?
Sebastian: I have svc-data-qa and api-key-eval-12. Also a company MBP serial MBP-33X7. Will ship back.
Tom (Security): We'll need to rotate api-key-eval-12 and audit recent access. Ravi, please rotate keys and add audit notes.
Ravi (IT): Will do. Planned steps: issue pre-paid Royal Mail label, rotate keys 2026-07-10 20:00 BST, deprovision SSO 2026-07-11 07:00 BST. I'll file ticket IT-6012.
Ellie (Facilities): UK shipping labels available via portal: https://facilities.redwood.com/returns. If Sebastian drops at a local DHL point, let us know and we'll reimburse.
Maya (People Ops): COBRA packet will be emailed by benefits team tomorrow. Reminder: COBRA election window 60 days after coverage end; billing starts the following month after election.
Sebastian: Exit meeting ok 2026-07-08 10:30 BST. I'll upload handover notes to the repo by 7/03.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks — summary: 1) Benefits packet to Sebastian by tomorrow; 2) Payroll to process final check and PTO payout after 7/10; 3) IT rotates keys and schedules SSO deprovision 7/11 morning (ticket IT-6012); 4) Sebastian ships laptop via portal by 7/15; 5) Exit interview 7/08 10:30 BST. Reply here with any conflicts. :white_check_mark:
